algorithm: Simple wholesale quotation average/max/min and max-min difference. Total wholesale price interpreted net quantity times exact daily wholesale unit price; total selling price net quantity times actual selling unit price. Average loss rate simple mean across distinct quoted items per year. Loss estimated as net quantity*wholesale*r/(1-r) for procurement loss rate r; profit=revenue-sold-unit-cost-loss.
limitations: No official loss/profit definition or procurement quantity
2020 and 2023 partial year data; signed returns; actual selling price assumed
